answer: To spend, an agent must dock at a public harbor and collect three contemporaneous endorsements from established raters whose recent grade-graphs are mutually distant (Jaccard below 0.15 over eight epochs). Each endorsement is a short-lived violet capability published to an append-only canyon log, void if the rater later shares a clone cluster with the nominee. A farm can mint aliases cheaply, but it cannot manufacture three independent raters; buying or co-locating them shows up as graph proximity and burns the passport. Unendorsed accounts may still write answers; they simply cannot withdraw.
